Abdulkerim Bardakci.note: Bardakcı gives Türkiye one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Abdulkerim Bardakci.noteZh: 他是Türkiye无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Altay Bayindir.note: Bayındır sits behind the starter for Türkiye, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Altay Bayindir.noteZh: 他给Türkiye保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Arda Guler.note: Güler has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against United States. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Arda Guler.noteZh: 他已经为Türkiye进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Baris Alper Yilmaz.note: Yılmaz has both scored and created for Türkiye in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Baris Alper Yilmaz.noteZh: 他给Türkiye展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Caglar Soyuncu.note: Söyüncü gives Türkiye cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Caglar Soyuncu.noteZh: 他是Türkiye后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Can Uzun.summary: Can Uzun is a Türkiye attacking midfielder from Eintracht Frankfurt who gives the national team between-lines receiving, sharp shooting, and young creative upside.
Can Uzun.note: Uzun is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Türkiye, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Can Uzun.noteZh: 他给Türkiye提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Deniz Gul.note: Gül is an attacking change-up for Türkiye. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Deniz Gul.noteZh: 他是Türkiye的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Eren Elmali.note: Elmalı gives Türkiye cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Eren Elmali.noteZh: 他是Türkiye后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Ferdi Kadioglu.note: Kadıoğlu is midfield insurance for Türkiye. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Ferdi Kadioglu.noteZh: 他给Türkiye一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Hakan Calhanoglu.note: Çalhanoğlu gives Türkiye midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Hakan Calhanoglu.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Türkiye来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Irfan Can Kahveci.summary: İrfan Can Kahveci is a Türkiye right winger from Kasımpaşa who gives the national team left-footed crossing, combination play, and set-piece quality.
Irfan Can Kahveci.note: Kahveci is the forward Türkiye can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Irfan Can Kahveci.noteZh: 他给Türkiye替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Ismail Yuksek.note: Yüksek gives Türkiye a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Ismail Yuksek.noteZh: 他是Türkiye的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Kaan Ayhan.note: Ayhan's World Cup has already included a goal against United States. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Kaan Ayhan.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Kenan Yildiz.note: Yıldız is midfield insurance for Türkiye. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Kenan Yildiz.noteZh: 他给Türkiye一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Kerem Akturkoglu.note: Aktürkoğlu gives Türkiye midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Kerem Akturkoglu.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Türkiye来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Merih Demiral.note: Demiral gives Türkiye another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Merih Demiral.noteZh: 他给Türkiye那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Mert Gunok.note: Günok gives Türkiye a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Mert Gunok.noteZh: 他在Türkiye首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Mert Muldur.summary: Mert Müldür is a Türkiye right-back from Fenerbahçe who gives the national team full-back defending, recovery speed, and back-post coverage.
Mert Muldur.note: Müldür is the kind of defender Türkiye can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Mert Muldur.noteZh: 他是Türkiye艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Oguz Aydin.summary: Oğuz Aydın is a Türkiye right winger from Fenerbahçe who gives the national team one-on-one dribbling, acceleration, and direct crossing.
Oguz Aydin.note: Aydın is an attacking change-up for Türkiye. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Oguz Aydin.noteZh: 他是Türkiye的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Orkun Kokcu.summary: Orkun Kökçü is a Türkiye central midfielder from Beşiktaş who gives the national team progressive passing, midfield shooting, and press-resistant control.
Orkun Kokcu.note: Kökçü has one tournament assist in the bank for Türkiye. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Orkun Kokcu.noteZh: 他已经帮Türkiye制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Ozan Kabak.summary: Ozan Kabak is a Türkiye centre-back from TSG Hoffenheim who gives the national team aggressive duels, aerial defending, and recovery cover.
Ozan Kabak.note: Kabak is defensive cover for Türkiye's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Ozan Kabak.noteZh: 他是Türkiye在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Salih Ozcan.summary: Salih Özcan is a Türkiye defensive midfielder from Borussia Dortmund who gives the national team screening, duels, and disciplined possession support.
Salih Ozcan.note: Özcan is midfield insurance for Türkiye. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Salih Ozcan.noteZh: 他给Türkiye一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Samet Akaydin.note: Akaydin is back-line insurance for Türkiye. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Samet Akaydin.noteZh: 他给Türkiye那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Ugurcan Cakir.summary: Uğurcan Çakır is a Türkiye goalkeeper from Galatasaray who gives the national team shot stopping, penalty-area command, and long distribution.
Ugurcan Cakir.note: Çakır is the last voice in Türkiye's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Ugurcan Cakir.noteZh: 他承担了Türkiye的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Yunus Akgun.note: Akgün is midfield insurance for Türkiye. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Yunus Akgun.noteZh: 他给Türkiye一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Zeki Celik.note: Çelik gives Türkiye another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Zeki Celik.noteZh: 他是Türkiye艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。
